proposals.title: Fix geocoder query so suburb listings don't collapse onto SF center
proposals.what: geocode() queries Nominatim with `{neighborhood}, {city}` which produces malformed strings like 'Fremont, CA, San Francisco' that never resolve, so listings fall back to a +/-3km jitter around SF center. Query the neighborhood/locality string as-is (drop the appended search city when the place already contains a locality), and only fall back to jitter as a last resort.
proposals.why: Fremont/Vallejo/Pleasant Hill listings showed impossible 2.6-3.0km distances from SF, wrongly passed the 20km filter, and piled onto downtown SF while a few correctly-resolved pins (El Cerrito, San Leandro) sat elsewhere — the map is internally inconsistent.

proposals.title: Cluster/spiderfy overlapping map pins
proposals.what: Add collision handling to the Leaflet map (marker clustering or spiderfy, or at minimum small offsets) so co-located price pins don't stack on top of each other unreadably.
proposals.why: Multiple price pins ($1200/$2295/$2074) render directly on top of one another near downtown SF and become illegible.

proposals.title: Add an empty state when filters exclude every listing
proposals.what: When filtered.length === 0 but listings exist, show a 'No places match — widen your price or distance' message with a reset action instead of a bare '0 of 0 fits' label over a blank void.
proposals.why: Dragging Max price to its floor left the sidebar showing 'SHORTLIST · 0 OF 0 FITS' with no message, no cards, and no map pins — a dead-end with zero guidance.

proposals.title: Surface the 409 when 'Owner replied' is clicked mid-turn
proposals.what: simulateReply ignores the fetch response; on a 409 ('A turn is already running') give the user feedback (toast/disabled-with-tooltip 'agent is mid-step, try again') instead of the button silently doing nothing.
proposals.why: Clicking 'Owner replied' during an active agent turn returned 409 and the UI gave zero feedback — only a console error; retrying after the turn settled returned 200.

proposals.title: Make the discovery Agent View feed human-readable
proposals.what: eventText falls back to raw H event type names, so the discovery feed is a wall of 'AgentEvent'/'MetricsUpdateEvent'/'RequestStartEvent'. Filter noise events and render meaningful narration (like the contact panel already does) so the live agent view actually reads as the agent thinking.
proposals.why: Discovery panel showed dozens of opaque event-type lines; the contact panel by contrast showed readable steps ('Opened WhatsApp deep link', 'Turn settled'), making the discovery feed look broken.

proposals.title: Scope discovery to the searched city, not the whole region
proposals.what: Searching 'San Francisco' starts on the regional sfbay Craigslist and returns mostly East Bay/Peninsula suburbs (Fremont, Vallejo, Concord, Martinez, San Mateo). Constrain the start URL / prompt to the searched city's neighborhoods or post-filter by distance so results match the promise.
proposals.why: Nearly all live results were 40-60km suburbs, not SF; combined with the geocode bug the 'places in San Francisco' framing is misleading.

proposals.title: Add a terminal/timeout state to the contact flow
proposals.what: After the owner reply was injected, the session ran 2+ minutes cycling raw events and never transitioned to the 'replied' success Toast; the card stayed on 'Contacting…'. Add a visible timeout/terminal state and progress so the flow can't hang silently during a demo.
proposals.why: Observed the contact card stuck on 'Contacting…' with RUNNING status past 02:11 and no success Toast within the window.
